caption_L1: Here a line plot is called Average ticket price for Miami Dolphins home games from 2006 to 2019 (in U.S. dollars). The x-axis measures Year along linear scale of range 2006 to 2018 while the y-axis measures Average ticket price in U.S. dollars along linear scale of range 0 to 100.
